gateway.intro: Lemonade works in both directions: its built-in tools are exposed as a Streamable HTTP MCP server, while Chat can use tools from connected HTTP endpoints or local MCP processes.
gateway.title: Lemon-Tools MCP server
gateway.description: Use Lemonade from Claude, VS Code, Cursor, MCP Inspector, or another MCP client.
gateway.copyAria: Copy MCP endpoint URL to clipboard
gateway.copyManual: Select and copy the URL manually

external.title: External MCP servers
external.summary: {{connected}}/{{total}} connected · HTTP endpoints and local processes · select up to four for Chat.
external.securityTitle: External MCP servers are unavailable on this server.
external.securityPrefix: Due to security constraints, using external MCP servers requires your server to be set up with either a general API key
external.securityOr: or a dedicated admin API key
external.securitySuffix: Set the respective environment variable in your Lemonade Server launch script, then restart the server to use this feature.
external.adminHint: Server requires admin API key to access external MCP feature setup.
external.adminApplied: Admin key applied for this app session.
external.unreachable: Could not reach MCP administration. Check that the server is running and reachable.
external.httpRecommendation: Recommended · connect to an MCP server already running in another app or service.
external.localHint: Let Lemonade start and supervise a command on this machine.
external.name: Name
external.endpointHint: Use the single Streamable HTTP endpoint exposed by the external application.
external.allowHttp: Allow unencrypted HTTP to a non-local address
external.allowHttpHint: Keep this off unless the endpoint is on a trusted private network. Localhost HTTP remains allowed.
external.httpsNeeded: This endpoint needs HTTPS, or the explicit insecure HTTP option above.
external.bearerNotePrefix: Bearer tokens are read from the lemond environment when connecting. Raw credentials are never stored in
external.localNote: Lemonade starts this command locally. Environment values must use references, and the referenced variables must exist in the lemond process environment.
external.empty: No external MCP server configured. Add an HTTP endpoint or a local process; built-in Lemonade tools remain available in Chat.

validation.safeReference: {{name}} must use the safe reference ${{{name}}}; raw secrets are not stored.
validation.envName: {{label}} must be an environment variable name such as MCP_API_TOKEN.
validation.endpointValid: Endpoint URL must be a valid http:// or https:// URL.
validation.endpointProtocol: Endpoint URL must use HTTP or HTTPS.
validation.endpointCredentials: Do not embed credentials in the endpoint URL.
validation.endpointFragment: Endpoint URL must not contain a fragment.
validation.insecureHttp: Plain HTTP is restricted to localhost. Use HTTPS or enable insecure HTTP in Advanced settings.
validation.timeout: Timeout must be between 1000 and 300000 ms.
validation.commandRequired: Command is required for a local process.
